columns.name: BUCKET_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to BUCKET_ID in FFS_QTS_BUCKET_PROFILE.

columns.name: QUOTA_LEVEL
columns.description: Level of quota the operation should be performed on.

columns.name: TIME_SLOT_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to TIME_SLOT_ID in FFS_TIME_SLOT.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to WORK_SKILL_ID in FFS_WORK_SKILL.

columns.name: FIELD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of quota field the operation should be performed for.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of this record that controls if the corresponding action is performed automatically.

columns.name: OPERATION
columns.description: Operation that should be performed.

columns.name: SOURCE_FIELD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the field that should be used as a source of data.

columns.name: SOURCE_OFFSET
columns.description: Offset of a first day/week that should be used as a source of data.

columns.name: SOURCE_COUNT
columns.description: Number of days/weeks that should be used as a source of data.

columns.name: TARGET_OFFSET
columns.description: Offset of a first day/week that should be populated.

columns.name: TARGET_COUNT
columns.description: Number of days/weeks that should be populated.

columns.name: MULTIPLY_BY
columns.description: Percent value for the percent_shift operation.

columns.name: RECURRENCE
columns.description: Defines when this operation should be performed automatically.

columns.name: DAY_OF_WEEK
columns.description: Day of week when this operation should be performed. Zero value means everyday.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Time of day when this operation should be performed.

columns.name: WITHIN
columns.description: Length of the time interval in minutes when schedule should be applied after start time. Zero value means that this applying window is disabled.

columns.name: UPDATED
columns.description: Time when the auto-populate parameters were changed last time.

columns.name: LAST_RUN
columns.description: Time when this operation was performed last time.

columns.name: NEXT_RUN
columns.description: Time when this operation is expected to be performed next time.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
